title: Turkish Portobello Doner Kebab
description: A vegetarian twist on the classic Turkish doner kebab, featuring marinated portobello mushrooms and served in a warm pita with toppings.

ingredients.name: Doner kebab spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together doner kebab spice blend, olive oil, and 1 tsp water.
Place portobello mushrooms in a large bowl and brush with spice mixture, making sure to coat both sides.
Grill mushrooms for 4-5 minutes per side, or until tender and slightly charred.
Warm Turkish bread by wrapping in foil and heating in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble kebabs by placing a grilled mushroom in each pita, topping with crumbled feta cheese, chopped parsley, and sliced tomato.
